text.en:
The second paragraph of suction four, of Act Numbered One hundred and eighty-five, be amended
so as to read as follows:
"There may be employed in the office of the Superintendent of Streets, Parks, Bridges, Docks, and Wharves,
one chief clerk of class seven; one clerk of class eight; one clerk of class nine; two clerks of class ten; and
one clerk of Class C; one chief inspector of class six; three district inspectors of class eight; two district
inspectors of class nine; and two district inspectors of Class C; one master of launch crews of class nine; one
foreman of stables of class nine; one assistant foreman of stables of Class A; one foreman of rock quarry of
Class A; one engineer of rock quarry of Class F; one engineer of road roller of Class A; one engineer of road
roller of Class C; and such engineers, foremen, gardeners, storekeepers, carpenters, masons, blacksmiths,
teamsters, launch crews, and laborers as may be authorized by law."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission,
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 13, 1901.
